principle: Model-Task Fitness Governs Pass Rate: matching model capability to task type (entailment→Sonnet, batch→Groq, brand→arthur-tuned) is the single largest driver of benchmark pass rate — more impactful than prompt engineering alone.
applicable_when: when selecting a model for a new task or routing a benchmark eval

principle: Zero-Novel-Pattern Modules Are Structurally Broken: if a module scores 0% on novel inputs but 100% on seen inputs, the rules are overfit to training examples and will fail in production. Treat zero novel-pattern score as a P0 bug, not a tuning issue.
applicable_when: when an eval shows 100% on repeated patterns but 0% on novel inputs

principle: Best-of-N Doesn't Rescue Mismatched Models: generating N candidates with the wrong model and picking the best still fails. Correct model selection first; only then apply best-of-N as an accuracy multiplier.
applicable_when: when considering best-of-N sampling to improve benchmark scores

principle: Iterative Refinement Converts Partial→Pass: a pipeline that scores 0% can reach 96% through 5 targeted iterations. Don't abandon a benchmark approach after the first PARTIAL — expect 3-5 partial deploys before a clean pass. The longmemeval-rag 0%→96% climb is the canonical example.
applicable_when: when a benchmark pipeline scores below 50% and the team is considering a rewrite

principle: High Novel-Pattern Rate Signals Underfitted Rules: when >20% of eval inputs trigger no matching rule, the rule set is too narrow. Expand trigger patterns before training more examples — routing is upstream of learning.
applicable_when: when a classifier routes more than 20% of inputs to a fallback

principle: When asked for an audit, enumerate every user role and walk through the product as each role before reporting done — skipping this caused a correction event.
applicable_when: when asked to audit a product or platform

applicable_when: when asked to audit a product or platform

principle: When a correction is detected, provide a detailed critique including the error message and any relevant suggestions.
applicable_when: when a correction is detected during any interaction

principle: When a user reports overdue financial obligations, escalate the issue to a designated expert for review and potential action.
applicable_when: when a user reports overdue financial obligations or threatened loan resumption

principle: When providing research or analysis, offer actionable insights and concrete next steps.
applicable_when: when presenting research findings or analysis to a user

principle: When unit-of-measure (UOM) mismatches are identified in pricing/costing, immediately apply the conversion factor and re-run full impact analysis before proceeding
trigger_conditions: Pricing analysis reveals items priced in one UOM but costed in another (e.g., EA vs LOT); margin calculations show extreme outliers (>100% or <-100%)
rationale: UOM errors cascade through revenue impact calculations. Trajectories [9,10] show correction of -856927% margin to ~15% after applying ÷1000 factor. Without this step, downstream decisions are invalid

principle: Prioritize critical and high-severity fixes before medium/low when fixing multiple issue classes
trigger_conditions: Audit or review surfaces issues with severity labels; limited deployment windows or rollout capacity
rationale: Risk mitigation: critical issues (RLS, webhooks, data leaks) block revenue or expose vulnerabilities; fixing these first maximizes impact per unit of effort

principle: Before executing financial calculations or tax filings, verify access to source-of-truth data systems; if access is blocked, escalate immediately rather than proceeding with assumptions
trigger_conditions: Task requires financial data (P&L, tax calculations, reconciliation); agent response includes 'credit balance too low' or similar access errors; agent proceeds with placeholder/assumed data
rationale: Trajectories [0,1] show credit balance errors blocking API access, yet tasks were marked 'accepted' without resolution. Trajectories [14,20] show tax calculations proceeding without actual financial data. Decisions based on assumptions create compliance risk

principle: Route financial/compliance tasks with deadlines and stakeholder pressure to Claude Sonnet; route straightforward data retrieval to Gemma 4 local
trigger_conditions: Task involves overdue financials, legal filings, debt schedules, or stakeholder threats; OR task is simple data extraction/reconciliation with no strategic reasoning required
rationale: Complex financial reasoning and stakeholder management require stronger reasoning; simple lookups waste resources on expensive models. Trajectories [1,4,13] routed to Sonnet for overdue Northern Initiatives; [19] incorrectly routed to Gemma 4 and failed to address urgency

principle: Run parallel audits when scope is large and issues are distributed across independent domains
trigger_conditions: Task involves 100+ potential issues; multiple subsystems (marketing, security, mobile, permissions, UI); no strict sequential dependencies
rationale: Parallelization reduces wall-clock time and allows independent teams to work on isolated concerns; trajectory [0] found 155 issues with 8 agents faster than serial approach would allow

principle: When a task involves urgent stakeholder communication (threats, past-due items, arrears), draft the outreach message and log the action in the same execution; do not defer communication
trigger_conditions: Task mentions past-due amounts, stakeholder threats, loan resumption risk, or finance charges; contact information is provided
rationale: Trajectories [1,4,12,13] involve past-due items and stakeholder contact info. [12,13] show drafting of outreach; [1,4] show acceptance without documented communication plan. Deferral increases arrears risk and damages relationships

principle: When initiating a deep dive into a market or competitor, consider the specific needs and pain points of the target customer segment.
applicable_when: when researching a new market or competitor

principle: When conducting research, explicitly state the tools and methods used to gather information.
applicable_when: when providing research results or insights

principle: When encountering a 'ping test', verify the Groq API key is set before proceeding.
applicable_when: when encountering a 'ping test' or any similar diagnostic request

principle: When encountering a cash flow issue, prioritize immediate solutions and route for quick review by a designated expert.
applicable_when: when a user reports low cash reserves or financial distress

principle: When asked for a summary of portfolio prep, provide a concise overview of high-priority tasks and key initiatives.
applicable_when: when asked for a daily or weekly summary of portfolio status

principle: For recurring unresolved issues (appearing 3+ times), escalate to root-cause investigation with MCP activation rather than repeating the same action
trigger_conditions: Same task appears multiple times in trajectory history with 'accepted' outcome but no resolution; task involves data reconciliation or system integration
rationale: Xero bank feed reconciliation appears in [0,3,11,18] with no permanent fix. Repeated attempts without escalation waste cycles. MCP activation in [18] signals correct approach but should have been triggered on first repeat

principle: Redeploy all affected edge functions after fixing permission/security issues to ensure consistency
trigger_conditions: Fixes involve RLS, access control, or webhook configuration; edge functions are involved
rationale: Edge function caches and stale deployments can reintroduce fixed vulnerabilities; full redeployment ensures all instances reflect fixes

principle: Establish context and readiness before accepting open-ended work requests
trigger_conditions: Agent receives greeting or minimal-context task; no explicit work item provided
rationale: Trajectories [2] and [3] show agents confirming availability and asking for direction; this prevents wasted cycles and ensures alignment on next steps

principle: When providing a summary or update, ensure it includes relevant context and actionable next steps for the user.
applicable_when: when providing a summary or update to a user

principle: When reporting on progress or completion, verify that all tasks and requirements have been met to avoid correction events.
applicable_when: when reporting build session completion or audit completion

principle: When a user requests a dashboard reconciliation, route for review by a designated expert to ensure accuracy and completeness.
applicable_when: when a user requests a dashboard reconciliation or audit

principle: When discussing product development, prioritize core functionality and MVP requirements.
applicable_when: when discussing product development or feature planning
